text_en: When Jacob learned that there was grain in Egypt, he said to his sons, “Why do you keep looking at one another?
text_cn: 雅各伯见埃及有粮食出售，便对自己的儿子们说：“你们为什么彼此观望？”

text_en: I have heard, ” he said, “that there is grain in Egypt; go down and buy grain for us there, that we may live and not die. ”
text_cn: 继而说：“我听说在埃及有粮食出售，你们下到那里，给我们购买些粮食，叫我们好活下去，不致饿死。”

text_en: So ten of Joseph’s brothers went down to buy grain in Egypt.
text_cn: 于是若瑟的十个哥哥下到埃及买粮食去了。

text_en: But Jacob did not send Joseph’s brother Benjamin with his brothers, for he feared that harm might come to him.
text_cn: 至于若瑟的弟弟本雅明，雅各伯没有叫他与哥哥们同去，因为他想：怕他遇害。

text_en: Thus the sons of Israel were among the other people who came to buy grain, for the famine had reached the land of Canaan.
text_cn: 这样以色列的儿子们也夹在前来购粮的人中，前来购粮，因为客纳罕地也发生了饥荒。

text_en: Now Joseph was governor over the land; it was he who sold to all the people of the land. And Joseph’s brothers came and bowed themselves before him with their faces to the ground.
text_cn: 当时在地方上执政的是若瑟，给地方上所有人民配售粮食的也是他。若瑟的哥哥们来了，就俯首至地，向他下拜。

text_en: When Joseph saw his brothers, he recognized them, but he treated them like strangers and spoke harshly to them. “Where do you come from? ” he said. They said, “From the land of Canaan, to buy food. ”
text_cn: 若瑟一见他的哥哥们，就认出他们来，却装做生人，向他们说了一些严厉的话，问他们说：“你们是从哪里来的？”他们答说：“我们是从客纳罕地来购买粮食的。”

text_en: Although Joseph had recognized his brothers, they did not recognize him.
text_cn: 若瑟认出哥哥们来，他们却没有认出他来。

text_en: Joseph also remembered the dreams that he had dreamed about them. He said to them, “You are spies; you have come to see the nakedness of the land! ”
text_cn: 于是若瑟想起了他昔日关于他们所作的梦，便对他们说：“你们是探子，前来刺探本地的虚实。”

text_en: They said to him, “No, my lord; your servants have come to buy food.
text_cn: 他们回答说：“我主！绝对不是；你的仆人们是来购买粮食的。

text_en: We are all sons of one man; we are honest men; your servants have never been spies. ”
text_cn: 我们全是一个人的儿子，我们是诚实人；你的仆人们从未做过探子。”

text_en: But he said to them, “No, you have come to see the nakedness of the land! ”
text_cn: 若瑟对他们说：“不，你们前来必是为刺探此地的虚实。”

text_en: They said, “We, your servants, are twelve brothers, the sons of a certain man in the land of Canaan; the youngest, however, is now with our father, and one is no more. ”
text_cn: 他们答说：“你的仆人们原是兄弟十二人，同是客纳罕地一个人的儿子；最小的现今在父亲那里，另一个已不在了。”

text_en: But Joseph said to them, “It is just as I have said to you; you are spies!
text_cn: 若瑟对他们说：“我才说你们是探子；这话实在不错。

text_en: Here is how you shall be tested: as Pharaoh lives, you shall not leave this place unless your youngest brother comes here!
text_cn: 为此我要考验你们：我指着法郎的生命起誓：如果你们最小的弟弟不到这里来，你们莫想离开此地。

text_en: Let one of you go and bring your brother, while the rest of you remain in prison, in order that your words may be tested, whether there is truth in you; or else, as Pharaoh lives, surely you are spies. ”
text_cn: 你们可由你们中派一个人回去，带你们的弟弟来，其他的人暂且拘留，以待证明你们的话是否诚实；如果不是真的，我指着法郎的生命起誓：你们必是探子。”

text_en: And he put them all together in prison for three days.
text_cn: 于是在拘留所内拘禁了他们三天。

text_en: On the third day Joseph said to them, “Do this and you will live, for I fear God:
text_cn: 第三天，若瑟对他们说：“我原是个敬畏天主的人，你们愿意保全性命，应这样做：

text_en: if you are honest men, let one of your brothers stay here where you are imprisoned. The rest of you shall go and carry grain for the famine of your households,
text_cn: 如果你们是诚实人，叫你们兄弟中一个人留在拘留所内，其余的人可带粮食回去，解救家中的饥荒。

text_en: and bring your youngest brother to me. Thus your words will be verified, and you shall not die. ” And they agreed to do so.
text_cn: 然后给我带你们的小弟弟来，好证实你们的话，你们也不致于死。”他们就这样作了。

text_en: They said to one another, “Alas, we are paying the penalty for what we did to our brother; we saw his anguish when he pleaded with us, but we would not listen. That is why this anguish has come upon us. ”
text_cn: 他们彼此说：“我们实在该赔补加害我们兄弟的罪，因为他向我们哀求时，我们见了他心灵痛苦，竟不肯听；为此这场苦难才落到我们身上！”

text_en: Then Reuben answered them, “Did I not tell you not to wrong the boy? But you would not listen. So now there comes a reckoning for his blood. ”
text_cn: 勒乌本就对他们说：“我岂不是对你们说过：不要伤害那孩子吗？你们却不肯听；看，现在要追讨他的血了。”

text_en: They did not know that Joseph understood them, since he spoke with them through an interpreter.
text_cn: 他们原不知道若瑟都听得懂，因为在他们中有一翻译员。

text_en: He turned away from them and wept; then he returned and spoke to them. And he picked out Simeon and had him bound before their eyes.
text_cn: 若瑟就由他们前退出去哭了。然后又回来与他们交谈，由他们中提出西默盎在他们眼前将他捆绑起来。

text_en: Joseph then gave orders to fill their bags with grain, to return every man’s money to his sack, and to give them provisions for their journey. This was done for them.
text_cn: 若瑟遂吩咐人将他们的布袋装满了粮食，将各人的银钱仍放在各人的布袋内，并且还给了他们途中所需要的食物；人就对他们这样做了。

text_en: They loaded their donkeys with their grain, and departed.
text_cn: 他们将购得的粮食驮在驴上，就从那里起身走了。

text_en: When one of them opened his sack to give his donkey fodder at the lodging place, he saw his money at the top of the sack.
text_cn: 到了客栈，他们中一人打开了布袋拿料喂驴，看见自己的银钱仍在布袋口，

text_en: He said to his brothers, “My money has been put back; here it is in my sack! ” At this they lost heart and turned trembling to one another, saying, “What is this that God has done to us? ”
text_cn: 遂对兄弟们说：“我的银钱退回来了；看，仍在我的袋里。”他们心惊起来，彼此战栗地说：“天主对我们所作的，是怎么一回事？”

text_en: When they came to their father Jacob in the land of Canaan, they told him all that had happened to them, saying,
text_cn: 他们回到客纳罕地，他们的父亲雅各伯那里，将所遇见的事全告诉他说：“

text_en: “The man, the lord of the land, spoke harshly to us, and charged us with spying on the land.
text_cn: 那地方的主人对我们说了一些严厉的话，将我们视作刺探那地方的人。

text_en: But we said to him, ‘We are honest men, we are not spies.
text_cn: 我们对他说：我们是诚实人，决不是探子；

text_en: We are twelve brothers, sons of our father; one is no more, and the youngest is now with our father in the land of Canaan. ’
text_cn: 我们原是兄弟十二人，同一父亲的儿子，一个已不在了，最小的现在同我们的父亲在客纳罕地。

text_en: Then the man, the lord of the land, said to us, ‘By this I shall know that you are honest men: leave one of your brothers with me, take grain for the famine of your households, and go your way.
text_cn: 那地方的主人对我们说：为叫我知道你们是诚实人，你们兄弟中一人留在我这里，其余的人带粮食回去解救家中的饥荒；

text_en: Bring your youngest brother to me, and I shall know that you are not spies but honest men. Then I will release your brother to you, and you may trade in the land. ’”
text_cn: 然后将你们的弟弟给我带来，那时我才能知道你们不是探子，确是诚实人，我将你们的兄弟还给你们，你们可在这地方自由行动。”

text_en: As they were emptying their sacks, there in each one’s sack was his bag of money. When they and their father saw their bundles of money, they were dismayed.
text_cn: 当他们倒自己的粮袋时，不料各人的钱囊仍在各人的袋内。他们和他们的父亲，一见钱囊，都害怕起来。

text_en: And their father Jacob said to them, “I am the one you have bereaved of children: Joseph is no more, and Simeon is no more, and now you would take Benjamin. All this has happened to me! ”
text_cn: 他们的父亲雅各伯对他们说：“你们总是使我丧失儿子：若瑟不在了，西默盎不在了，你们还要带走本雅明！这一切都落在我身上！”

text_en: Then Reuben said to his father, “You may kill my two sons if I do not bring him back to you. Put him in my hands, and I will bring him back to you. ”
text_cn: 勒乌本对他父亲说：“如果我不将他给你带回来，你可杀死我的两个儿子；只管将他交在我手里，我必再还给你。”

text_en: But he said, “My son shall not go down with you, for his brother is dead, and he alone is left. If harm should come to him on the journey that you are to make, you would bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to Sheol. ”
text_cn: 雅各伯答说：“我儿子不能和你们一同下去，因为他哥哥死了，只剩下了他独自一个；如果他在你们行的路上遇到什么不幸，那你们就要使我这白发老人在忧苦中降入阴府了。”
